Marinos|Marinos]] (13 October) | lowest attendance = 4,014 – [[JEF United Chiba|JEF Utd.]] vs. [[Gamba Osaka|Gamba]] (31 October) | average attendance = 16,548 | prevseason = [[2000 J.League Division 1|2000]] | nextseason = [[2002 J.League Division 1|2002]] }} The '''2001 J.League Division 1 season''' was the ninth season since the establishment of the [[J1 League|J.League Division 1]]. The league began on March 10 and ended on November 24. At the end of the season, the second stage winner [[Kashima Antlers]] won the [[J.League Championship|Suntory Championship]] against [[Júbilo Iwata]] who won the first stage. ==Clubs== The following sixteen clubs participated in J.League Division 1 during 2001 season.
